Prevention: Plant two weeks after onset of rains
Use certified seed from known seed dealers.
Treat seeds with fungicides prior planting such as
Practice crop rotation with other crops preferably legumes soybean, groundnuts, cowpea.
Sorghum should not follow maize in the rotation.
Remove or plough deep (bury) crop residues after harvest
Johnson grass from the field on nearby fields.
Remove volunteer sorghum plants in the field
Monitoring: Scout for small tan to reddish‐purple circular
Spots on the leaves, and midrib starting 4 weeks after planting
Start controlling when 20% of the plant parts (leaves) show symptoms and at least 20% of the field is affected
Direct Control: When isolated plants are affected, uproot and burn or bury at least 15cm deep.
Restrictions: When using a pesticide always wear protective clothing.
Follow the instructions on the product label such as dosage, timing of spray, pre-harvest interval, application rate, restricted re-entry interval.
WHO U, unlikely to pose health hazard.
